objects.name: BitWarden security advisory (AV26-683)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-683 Date: July 10, 2026 On July 8, 2026, BitWarden published security advisories to address a vulnerability in the following product: Bitwarden Server – versions prior to 2026.6.2 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates.
